glosses: to drive into, to run into (to collide with while driving)

examples.text: Pijany mężczyzna najechał na przechodzącą przez pasy matkę z dzieckiem.
examples.translation: A drunken man ran into a mother and child crossing the street.
examples.english: A drunken man ran into a mother and child crossing the street.

glosses: to invade, to raid to assail, to encroach (to enter by force, usually in order to conquer)

examples.text: Rosja najechała Ukrainę po uprzednim zainscenizowaniu fałszywych prowokacji.
examples.translation: Russia invaded Ukraine after staging false provocations.
examples.english: Russia invaded Ukraine after staging false provocations.

glosses: to come down on, to go off, to snap, to bite the head off (to severely berate someone; to attack someone verbally)

examples.text: Mój kumpel ostro na mnie najechał, gdy dowiedział się, że przespałem się z jego siostrą.
examples.translation: My buddy came down hard on me when he found out that I had slept with his sister.
examples.english: My buddy came down hard on me when he found out that I had slept with his sister.

glosses: to cause something to come within range of some moving device

examples.translation: The cameraman pointed the camera at the actors.
examples.english: The cameraman pointed the camera at the actors.

glosses: to arrive in large numbers or one by one by driving

examples.text: W te wakacje najechało się w góry mnóstwo Arabów.
examples.translation: A lot of Arabs have come to the mountains on this vacation.
examples.english: A lot of Arabs have come to the mountains on this vacation.

glosses: to feel tired and to lose the desire to continue driving due to driving for too long

examples.text: Teraz ty prowadzisz, ja się dzisiaj już wystarczająco najechałem.
examples.translation: You're driving now, I've had enough driving for today.
examples.english: You're driving now, I've had enough driving for today.

examples.text: Germanie najechali Cesarstwo Rzymskie i zakończyli czasy starożytne.
